title: The Day the Colors Ran Away
author: Hamidreza Rostami
short_description: A boy must convince the colors to return to a gray world.
long_description: Milo loves colors, but one morning he wakes up to a world without them—everything is gray! Determined to fix things, he sets out on a quest and discovers that the colors have taken a day off. Red, Blue, Green, and Yellow explain that being a color is hard work and no one appreciates them. Milo must convince them that the world needs them and that he will always appreciate their beauty. A vibrant story about appreciation, creativity, and the magic of color.

main_characters.name: Milo
main_characters.description: A boy with messy brown hair, freckles, and a red shirt. He has a determined expression and carries a crayon box.
